crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast, circular orange-red patch located on the posterior crown/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A diffuse, non-linear color transition boundary separating the white-grey crown from the medium-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white plumage patch on the forehead and anterior crown region.
